aboutHeading: Landscaping in Briar Hill for Years
aboutText: Pierre The Landscaper has been transforming gardens in Briar Hill and Melbourne's north-eastern suburbs for over a decade. Specialising in both softscaping and hardscaping, we handle everything from planting and mulching to paving and retaining walls. Our team is dedicated to creating beautiful, functional outdoor spaces tailored to your needs, using quality materials and expert craftsmanship.
servicesText: From initial design to ongoing maintenance, Pierre The Landscaper offers a full range of services. Whether you need new turf, a custom irrigation system, or a complete garden overhaul, we have the expertise to deliver quality results in Briar Hill and beyond.

services.title: Softscaping & Planting
services.desc: Expert planting, mulching, and garden bed design to bring your outdoor space to life with vibrant flora and healthy soil.

services.title: Hardscaping & Paving
services.desc: Professional paving, retaining walls, and garden edging to create structured, durable features that enhance your property's appeal.

services.title: Turf Installation
services.desc: Quality turfing and synthetic turf options for a lush, low-maintenance lawn that stays green all year round in Briar Hill.

services.title: Irrigation Systems
services.desc: Efficient irrigation solutions to keep your garden hydrated and healthy, reducing water waste and saving you time.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular upkeep including pruning, weeding, and general care to maintain your garden's beauty and prevent overgrowth.

services.title: Excavation & Earthworks
services.desc: Site preparation and excavation services for garden beds, paths, and other landscaping projects, ensuring a solid foundation.
